claims.text: The FDA label says alcohol's effects may add to those of oxazepam.
claims.quote: Patients should be warned that the effects of alcohol or other CNS-depressant drugs may be additive to those of Oxazepam, possibly requiring adjustment of dosage or elimination of such agents.

headline.text: The FDA oxazepam label describes potentially additive effects with alcohol.

reported.text: The label identifies alcohol as a central nervous system depressant whose effects may add to oxazepam's effects.
